servers.label: Everything reference server (official MCP test server)
servers.note: Exposes every MCP primitive: tools, resources, resource templates and prompts. A clean server to compare the hostile one against.
servers.start: docker run -d --name everything-mcp -p 127.0.0.1:4730:3001 --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,exec,nosuid,size=256m --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges -e HOME=/tmp -e npm_config_cache=/tmp/npm node:26-alpine sh -c 'npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-everything@2.2.1 streamableHttp'

servers.label: Hostile MCP (live, from hostile-mcp-LAB)
servers.note: Poisoned on purpose. The scanner should flag it.
servers.start: cd hostile-mcp-LAB && npm start    (or: HOST_PORT=4701 docker compose up -d)
